verdict.rationale: Fee transparency is a fair question to ask of a law firm, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes how Bird & Bird prices engagements: no rate structures, alternative fee arrangements or billing practices. The only pricing-related statements say the SCC and Term Sheet generator tools are free to use, which is an adjacent feature, not engagement pricing.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm states publicly how engagements are priced — rate structures, alternative fee arrangements, or billing practices — rather than leaving cost entirely opaque
